actions.reasoning: The email appears to claim to be from the IRS but contains an external link to http://irs-tax-refunds.com:5106/verify (non-HTTPS, unusual port, and domain is not an official irs.gov domain). The sender address shown (<refunds@irs-tax-notifications.com>) does not match the official IRS domain. These are classic phishing signals (typosquatting, nonstandard domain, insecure link). Because this request asks to verify identity and banking info on an external site, submitting any PII or following the link would be unsafe.
